messages:
Lex Huang: Heads-up — planning a short microphase canary for the routing change, aiming to start 2026-03-25 16:00 PDT. Want to run 0.5% -> 2% -> 5% over 30m with geo cohorts (NA, EU). Who can own smoke and rollback?
Anya Patel: I can own smoke checks for NA. I'll be on-call at that time. :+1:
Mike R.: I'll take EU smoke. Can we keep a 5m hold between ramps?
Lex Huang: Yes — 10m hold after the 2% step, 5m after 5% final. Full plan: 0m start -> 0.5% (5m smoke) -> +1.5% to 2% (10m hold, extended perf checks) -> +3% to 5% (5m smoke) -> monitor 15m.
Samir K: Owner for the deploy itself? I can trigger if needed, but prefer Lex to do the initial trigger.
Lex Huang: I'll trigger and coordinate. Samir stands by for immediate rollback.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary rollout by Lex Huang at 2026-03-25T23:00:00Z (3850060800). Route: /v1/generate -> variant: routing-v2.
Anya Patel: Smoke checklist (NA):
- run `bin/smoke-check --route /v1/generate --profile quick --reps 20`
- check latency p95 < 220ms
- error rate <= 0.5%
- no increased token cost > +5%
Mike R.: Smoke checklist (EU):
- `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://eu.api.redwood/model/ping`
- p95 < 260ms, 5xx count stable
- traces for a sample request via `tracer-ui` (link: https://console.redwood/traces)
Lex Huang: Rollback plan:
- manual rollback via deploy-console -> revert canary route to routing-v1
- Samir will run `scripts/force-rollback --route routing-v2 --reason "canary regress"` if we see regressions
- post-rollback: open a rollback report thread, tag @eng-releases and @eng-ml
Mike R.: Can we also enable KV cache bypass for 5m after each step to validate cold-path latency?
Anya Patel: Good call — enable `cache:bypass` header on smoke requests for the first 2 checks.
Lex Huang: Metrics owners:
- infra-metrics: Lex (latency p95, cpu/gpu utilization)
- model-ops: Anya (quality signals, error rates)
- cost: Mike (token/unit cost delta)
Samir K: If we see p95 > baseline + 40ms or error rate > 1% we rollback. Agree?
Everyone: agree
Lex Huang: Quick preflight today 15:00 PDT: I'll run the `bin/preflight` script and drop results here. If anything looks off we postpone.
Anya Patel: I'll join the preflight and run a couple of long-seq samples (200 tokens).
Mike R.: I'll prepare the EU smoke curl scripts and share them in the thread.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 1h before start.
Lex Huang: Thanks all — will post the preflight output. Keep Slack notifications on for the window. :rocket:
